assumptions: Bare actuator model: NO main horn, idler horn, bracket, spacer, mounting screw, cable or mating plug is installed. The published HINGE drawing depicts accessory horns; its 8 x M2 x 0.4/PCD 16 circles are deliberately excluded from bare-case mount groups and geometry.

Case frame is long X 0 .. 46.5, width Y 0 .. 28.5, rear/idler face Z 0 and main face Z 34. Source axis is 11.25 from the near short edge and on the transverse centerline Y 14.25. Axis plane origins are reference points on the same line, not measured physical shaft roots.

Four formal mounting planes expose 14 source-backed M2.5 x 0.45 case tap centers. DP 3.0(MAX.) is a maximum source callout only; no minimum safe engagement or allowed screw length is inferred. Visible 1.2 mm shallow major-diameter pockets are illustrative markers, not thread/tap-drill geometry.

The near short end shows two extra taps, but its transverse registration is not separately dimensioned in that view. These two visual pockets use the opposite-end column spacing as a PREVIEW assumption and have no published mount group.

Main coupling D 6 x 2.6 at Z 32.6 and rear annulus D 15/D 10 x 1.2 are provisional visual markers only. Horn seating, bare spline/tooth form, rear retention interface and all formal shaft height extents remain unknown.

Two detachable bus receptacles occupy opposed long-side rear-cover windows. Shell dimensions/coordinates, contact marker 2.5 pitch and latch/key/insertion clearances are PREVIEW planning geometry; contact counts are sourced. No intrinsic cable bundles or conductors are asserted.

The grey body and amber markers are display colors for feature visibility, not an assertion of factory material/finish. Edge radii, cover seams, screw-head shapes and rear cover details are simplified.

observations.note: W350 T and R share the published 28.5 x 46.5 x 34 case envelope; gear ratio 353.5:1. The suffix distinguishes TTL3-contact and RS-4854-contact interfaces, not an inferred geometry revision.

Official X 430 download 157 resolves to the ROBOTIS-published XM,H-430_idler.pdf, dated 2019 / 03 / 19 and titled XM430/XH430(HINGE). It depicts installed main/idler horns. Those accessory 8 x M2 x 0.4/PCD 16 holes, horn circles and protrusion dimensions are not bare-case mounting or bare shaft dimensions.

Case taps are M2.5 x 0.45 with DP 3.0(MAX.). Four declared planes expose 14 source-located body mounting centers. Nominal thread-major reference circles are not tap-drill or clearance holes; maximum depth is not minimum usable engagement.
Near-end two-tap appearance is retained as simplified geometry only; its transverse registration is not separately dimensioned in that view. No formal near-end mounting group is asserted.
Connector Information identifies TTL JST B3B-EH-A PCB header and EHR-03 mating housing. Model includes two static receptacles and no attached plugs/cables.

Official back-case wiring illustrations show the two detachable PCB headers and the rear hollow routing opening. Case-window and connector-shell positions are qualitative, not pixel-measured dimensions.
Internal PCB/back-case photograph confirms two electrical headers; one cable may be routed through the hollow idler area. The cable path is distinct from the receptacle count.
XM430-W210 manual links the identical official X 430 drawing download 157. This is a mechanical-reference crosslink only; no W210 electrical/performance identity or new W210 asset is implied.
Official item 902-0124-000 identifies XM430-W350-T. Included HN12-N101 horn and cables are separate package components and are not modeled as installed accessories.

assumptions: Bare actuator model: NO main horn, idler horn, bracket, spacer, mounting screw, cable or mating plug is installed. The published HINGE drawing depicts accessory horns; its 8 x M2 x 0.4/PCD 16 circles are deliberately excluded from bare-case mount groups and geometry.

Case frame is long X 0 .. 46.5, width Y 0 .. 28.5, rear/idler face Z 0 and main face Z 34. Source axis is 11.25 from the near short edge and on the transverse centerline Y 14.25. Axis plane origins are reference points on the same line, not measured physical shaft roots.

Four formal mounting planes expose 14 source-backed M2.5 x 0.45 case tap centers. DP 3.0(MAX.) is a maximum source callout only; no minimum safe engagement or allowed screw length is inferred. Visible 1.2 mm shallow major-diameter pockets are illustrative markers, not thread/tap-drill geometry.

The near short end shows two extra taps, but its transverse registration is not separately dimensioned in that view. These two visual pockets use the opposite-end column spacing as a PREVIEW assumption and have no published mount group.

Main coupling D 6 x 2.6 at Z 32.6 and rear annulus D 15/D 10 x 1.2 are provisional visual markers only. Horn seating, bare spline/tooth form, rear retention interface and all formal shaft height extents remain unknown.

Two detachable bus receptacles occupy opposed long-side rear-cover windows. Shell dimensions/coordinates, contact marker 2.5 pitch and latch/key/insertion clearances are PREVIEW planning geometry; contact counts are sourced. No intrinsic cable bundles or conductors are asserted.

The grey body and amber markers are display colors for feature visibility, not an assertion of factory material/finish. Edge radii, cover seams, screw-head shapes and rear cover details are simplified.

observations.note: W350 T and R share the published 28.5 x 46.5 x 34 case envelope; gear ratio 353.5:1. The suffix distinguishes TTL3-contact and RS-4854-contact interfaces, not an inferred geometry revision.

Official X 430 download 157 resolves to the ROBOTIS-published XM,H-430_idler.pdf, dated 2019 / 03 / 19 and titled XM430/XH430(HINGE). It depicts installed main/idler horns. Those accessory 8 x M2 x 0.4/PCD 16 holes, horn circles and protrusion dimensions are not bare-case mounting or bare shaft dimensions.

Case taps are M2.5 x 0.45 with DP 3.0(MAX.). Four declared planes expose 14 source-located body mounting centers. Nominal thread-major reference circles are not tap-drill or clearance holes; maximum depth is not minimum usable engagement.
Near-end two-tap appearance is retained as simplified geometry only; its transverse registration is not separately dimensioned in that view. No formal near-end mounting group is asserted.
Connector Information identifies RS-485 JST B4B-EH-A PCB header and EHR-04 mating housing. Model includes two static receptacles and no attached plugs/cables.

Official back-case wiring illustrations show the two detachable PCB headers and the rear hollow routing opening. Case-window and connector-shell positions are qualitative, not pixel-measured dimensions.
Internal PCB/back-case photograph confirms two electrical headers; one cable may be routed through the hollow idler area. The cable path is distinct from the receptacle count.
